'''Blanco''' was a perky [[Gender/Legends|female]] of unidentified species. She was seen in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], the City of Masks, in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. Like all the visitors and many inhabitants, this person was in disguise, particularly in a white-and-silver gown, with web silver covering it. She was seen dancing in [[Club 111]] in a fast style, equivalent to her conversation style.
